label: copy-phase input g (fed-back g) at mid-sequence recall positions
explanation: Token-specific copy-phase feature: fires almost exclusively (99.8% of mass) when the fed-back input token is g during the copy phase, i.e. the step right after the model output g. Never fires in the original or delimiter phases, nor on the first occurrence of g. Strongly position-gated: activity concentrates at recall_idx 3-5 (g was original token 2-4) with at least 2 outputs remaining; strongest examples have g as the 3rd original token in L=9 sequences (recall_idx 3, t=12). Near-zero on copied g in short sequences (L<=5), at recall_idx <=2, or near the end of the copy. Other input tokens essentially never activate it. Predicate on dev: P 0.76, R 0.83, F1 0.79, mass recall 0.94; the bare in_tok==g copy-phase rule has mass recall 0.998 but precision 0.25.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=11: g, 2, l; t=12: g, 2, l, i; t=13: g, 0, x) and the previous input (most: i, l, 2, r, g, x; least: v, s, t, <DEL>); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=12.
